simple.meaning: צָדוֹק (Tsâdôwq) appears 53 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship and in connection with priesthood.

definitions.short: Tsadok , the name of eight or nine Israelites
definitions.full: H6659. Tsadoq צָדוֺק , and ( 1Kin 1:26 ) צָדֹק 54 proper name, masculine (just, righteous; compare Sabean proper name צדק CIS iv, No. 287, 1.2.11.15 etc. , DHM Hof Museum, No. 32 ); — σαδωκ, σαδδονκ (compare Lag BN 225 ff. ); — 1 48 priests: a. David's time 2Sam 8:17 = 1Chr 18:16 ; 2Sam 15:24-25 , 23 t. Samuel Kings Chronicles, + (Solomon's time) 1Kin 2:35 = 1Chr 29:22 ; 1Kin 4:2 , 4 ; ancestor of צָדוֺק דְּנֵי Ezek 40:46 ; 44:15 ; 48:11 , צ ׳זֶרַע 43:19 , צ ׳בֵּית 2Chr 31:10 ; descendant of Eleazar 1 Chronicles 5:34 (twice in verse) + 5t. Chronicles. b. 1 Chronicles 5:38 (twice in verse), possibly = c. 1Chr 9:11 ; Neh 11:11 . 2 father-in-law of Uzziah 2Kin 15:33 2Chron 27:11. 3 two wall-builders: a. Neh 3:4 . b. Neh 3:29 ; perhaps = c. Neh 10:22 , and d. ׳צ הַסּוֺפֵר Neh 13:13 .
